description: Use this when the user asks about events in aging research and the longevity industry: company financings and deals, trial readouts, approvals and regulators, policy, conferences. One story per event, newest first, written by AgingResearch.News with a link to every outlet that covered it. Narrow by words, kind or date. Only news of this field; not for general, political or market news.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page. Keep the other parameters the same.

q.description: Words that must all appear in the story's headline or summary (case-insensitive).

since.description: Only stories with coverage on or after this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: list_news
